result.brief: HUG-VIS 构建了包含同步视频、音频、文本与 alpha 抠像的人体中心多模态基准，覆盖情感识别、人体视频生成、语音克隆与视频抠像四类任务，并提供统一零样本评测与跨任务分析。
result.reason: Benchmark spans emotion recognition, human video generation, voice cloning, and matting; it is a dataset/evaluation resource rather than a model or representation contribution, so transfer to stated goals is indirect.
